name: Ice Lead Notification Default
htmlBodyTemplate:
A new quote request was submitted for IceSkatingRinkRentals.com.

Name{{lead.fullName}}
Email{{lead.email}}
Phone{{lead.phone}}
Event city/state{{lead.eventCity}}, {{lead.eventState}}
Event date or range{{lead.eventDateOrDateRange}}
Event type{{lead.eventType}}
Venue setting{{lead.venueSetting}}
Estimated attendance{{lead.estimatedAttendance}}
Message{{lead.message}}

FormEntry ID: {{formEntry.id}}
Submitted at: {{formEntry.submittedAt}}
Source page: {{formEntry.sourcePage}}

Review the lead in Pumpkin Lead Inbox. Do not rely on this email as the source of truth.

variables.lead.fullName: Submitter name from sanitized FormEntry formData.
variables.lead.email: Submitter email from sanitized FormEntry formData.
variables.lead.phone: Submitter phone from sanitized FormEntry formData.
variables.lead.eventCity: Event city from sanitized FormEntry formData.
variables.lead.eventState: Event state from sanitized FormEntry formData.
variables.lead.eventDateOrDateRange: Event date/range from sanitized FormEntry formData.
variables.lead.eventType: Event type from sanitized FormEntry formData.
variables.lead.venueSetting: Venue setting from sanitized FormEntry formData.
variables.lead.estimatedAttendance: Estimated attendance from sanitized FormEntry formData.

noSecretGuardrails: Do not include SMTP credentials, provider tokens, mailbox passwords, DKIM private keys, or raw API keys in template variables.
Do not include full raw email payloads in outbound logs.
Use FormEntry id and safe lead fields only.
notes: Draft, disabled, and dry-run-only until Microsoft 365 setup and explicit sending approval.
The selected primary mailbox/user is contact@iceskatingrinkrentals.com, represented only through refs here.
Graph/OAuth is the preferred future app-sending path; SMTP AUTH is fallback only if enabled later.
Pumpkin Lead Inbox remains the source of truth for submitted forms.
